coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Andhra Pradesh state cadastral mapping platform and Eluru district land-record modernization status; municipal map coverage is limited to the published city-map/Sachivalayam UI.

blocker: No anonymous, city-scoped parcel geometry and native parcel identity were verified. The official state cadastral portal timed out; the official local land-record page is a placeholder; and the municipal map endpoint exposes only a Sachivalayam locator whose current data route returned 404.
remainingUncertainty: Eluru district cadastral maps and land parcels are evidenced by official DILRMP status material, and Andhra Pradesh operates an official Bhunaksha platform, but city-level public geometry availability, schema, CRS and native IDs remain unverified. No absence of cadastral records is inferred.
nextStep: Retry the official Bhunaksha portal when reachable, follow its current anonymous viewer configuration, and request only a bounded Eluru-area geometry-plus-safe-ID response. Validate CRS and location before considering adapter qualification.
identityPolicy: Retain only stable native parcel identities; never substitute internal row numbers. No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe native parcel identity and geometry were verified.
registryBasis: Official Andhra Pradesh Bhunaksha identifies the state cadastral-mapping custodian, the official Eluru district land-records route identifies the local district administration, and DILRMP provides Eluru-district cadastral status evidence. These establish relevant registry/cadastral custody, not an open city parcel API.
